title: Twenty-two
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Five years of the strip. Twenty-two years of Wood. The anniversary and the birthday in one week; the strip does one panel for each and two for the dog.

panels.composition: The frame shop backroom. A cupcake with a single candle on the mat cutter. GULLY lighting it. WOOD pretending not to see.

image.prompt: a young man in a backwards cap lighting a single candle on a cupcake set on a mat cutter while another young man pretends to keep working, framing backroom, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Wood blowing it out. A tray of corn beside it, because it's also the twelfth.

balloons.text: Also five years of the strip. Yesterday.
You put corn on the workbench for a comic.
Since I said so. Three times now.

image.prompt: a young man blowing out a candle on a cupcake beside a paper tray of corn on a workbench

panels.composition: BARNABY, standing up on hind legs at the bench, nose at the cupcake.

characters.pose: up on hind legs at the bench

image.prompt: a scruffy dog standing on its hind legs with its nose at a cupcake on a workbench

panels.composition: Barnaby with frosting on his nose. Both men watching him. The candle out. The strip's fifth birthday is a dog with frosting.
